notes.title: ENIGMA: Version 1.3 Released
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26010749/a24332d028f5f4b2b43e4b9b52f0e468c2e16b31.png
Version 1.3 of ENIGMA: is now live with a number of improvements.

Changes:
Improved the spacing of menu items (requires starting a new game from main menu)
Fixes:
Fixed a bug allowing you to try to load empty save slots
Corrected the text in the background of empty save slots
Fixed a bug that would in some scenes leave graphic artifacts on the left side of the screen if playing in full-screen mode
